positive.point: Vanguard's simplicity and bare-bones approach is appreciated by users who prefer straightforward interfaces.
The ability to see transaction history and details on the Vanguard website is valued by users for thorough checking.

negative.point: Users find it difficult to identify the type of account they have on the Vanguard dashboard.
Frustration with the lack of detailed information on certain funds within 403b accounts.
Difficulty in finding receipts for gifts-in-kind donations on the Vanguard website.
The mobile app lacks detailed transaction information compared to the website.
Vanguard's site is often delayed in updating transaction information.
Challenges in finding banking transaction history on Vanguard's platform.
